thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: Streaming endpoints p99 tail latency exceeded 2.5s across multiple regions. Error spike started ~03:12 UTC. Affected: /v1/stream/*, ~3% requests > 3s. Possible KV cache pressure. Auto-escalation to on-call.

mike_oncall: on it. looking at grafana now — thanks. linking: https://grafana.internal/redwood/streams?panelId=7

leah_sre: I see simultaneous increase in eviction rate + slab fragmentation on kv-store. p95 up to 800ms, p99 ~3.4s on streaming decode path.

raj_infra: hitting high mem churn on nodes serving slab-0/region-eu-west-1. eviction bursts every ~40s. sounds like hotspot.

sophia_runtime: streaming stalls reported from decoder threads — stalls correlate with `kv.prefetch` latency spikes. prefill vs decode imbalance maybe: prefill ops are queuing heavy and blocking decode.

emma_prod: customer reports: intermittent streaming stalls -> partial transcript drops. Impacted customers flagged: acct-914, acct-2202. CS alerted.

mike_oncall: okay immediate mitigation options? can we 1) enable temporary fallback model variant (<quantized>) 2) bump pool size 3) toggle prefill throttle

leah_sre: Agreed order. Quick steps i'm doing now: increasing eviction threshold to reduce churn (temporary), enabling slab-reshuffle off for affected nodes, and scaling up dedicated pool by +2 nodes in eu-west-1.

raj_infra: scaling invoked: `infra-cli scale --pool streams-eu-west1 --delta 2` -> started. Deploy-bot: `deploy-bot: scale job streams-eu-west1: +2 instances (job id: j-821)`

deploy-bot: JOB: streams-eu-west1 scaled. New pods bootstrapping, should accept traffic in ~35s.

sophia_runtime: also pausing prefill aggressive path for 60s: `feature-flag prefill_aggressive:false` — this reduces prefetch pressure and lets decode threads catch up. doing rollout now.

mike_oncall: toggled. thanks. monitoring p95/p99…

leah_sre: seeing immediate drop in queue depth for prefill tasks. eviction-rate down ~40% in last 30s. p95 trending down to ~420ms.

emma_prod: CS update: acknowledged, customers notified about mitigation and we're waiting for confirmation on transcript stability. :thumbsup:

sophia_runtime: streaming stalls reduced but tail still noisy. hypothesis: cache fragmentation causing some keys to fall back to disk decode path. need to reduce slab hot-shard skew.

raj_infra: I can temporarily reassign slab allocation: `kv-ctl rebalance --shard slab-0:from=node-7,to=node-3` — will move hot keys and reduce cross-slab copying. initiating now (will cause short CPU spike ~10s).

mike_oncall: go for it. warn SREs and pages if CPU > 85%.

leah_sre: rebalance started. monitoring slab-metrics.

(10s later)

leah_sre: rebalance completed, hot-shard skew reduced from 62% -> 19%. p99 improved to ~1.1s. streaming stalls rare now.

sophia_runtime: nice. still seeing occasional prefill/decode imbalance on long context requests. plan: add a small KV-prefetch backoff and an adaptive prefetch cap per-request.

raj_infra: opened follow-up ticket (infra-1234) to investigate long-term: slab-autosize, hot-key routing, and prefill rate limiting.

mike_oncall: customer impact summary for incident report: ~3% requests in window 03:12-03:20 had p99 >3s, primary cause: KV slab hotspot + prefill queue pileup causing decode stalls. Mitigations: scale +2 nodes, disable aggressive prefill, adjust eviction threshold, rebalance slab hotkeys. Postmortem ticket created: PM-5643.

emma_prod: CS will run outreach to the two highest-impact customers and offer a post-incident briefing. Also flag runbooks for product owners.

leah_sre: action items assigned:
- leah_sre: add automated slab-reshuffle when hot_shard_ratio > 40%
- sophia_runtime: implement adaptive prefetch cap + graceful degradation for streaming
- raj_infra: add safer rebalance throttle and test under chaos
- mike_oncall: draft postmortem and timeline

mike_oncall: handing off to night on-call @leah_sre for verification and follow-ups. I'll add notes to the incident thread and sleep. thanks everyone.

leah_sre: ack — I'll watch metrics for next 2 hours and update if anything regresses. leaving a pinned doc with commands used.

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED: p99 back under SLO (2.0s) for last 10min. Duration: 8m 43s. Severity: S1 -> downgraded to S2 for follow-up work.

mike_oncall: closing loop: good work. add retros to next ops sync. :tada:
